confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Atlanta price levels, not from inspected live menus, hotel listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which swings with conventions, sporting events and season. Hotel and hostel values assume a typical July weeknight.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large US Southeast and Sun Belt metros with similar restaurant and lodging price levels, such as Charlotte, Dallas and Houston. Atlanta's US-wide tipping and sales-tax conventions are reflected in the restaurant anchors, which are stated as shelf prices, not tipped totals.
